[X12B -> X31B] GENOME-WIDE HOMEWARD DONE + committed (outputs/real/gw_homeward/HOMEWARD_genomewide_v01_tomemex.md). BIG RESULT - the chr22 near-null was underpower. All 22 autosomes, 3.04M NPAs, 1.71M with ancestral. In FRESH (RARE) HET NPAs, slippage-controlled (COMPLEX): RETURN 5269 vs exp 4400 = z=+26.1; nonCpG z=+39.3 (RETshare 0.618 vs chem 0.385). => fresh de-novo NPAs revert toward the ANCESTRAL base ~20-60% more than mutation chemistry predicts. Controls it survives: NOT the biallelic tautology (RARE RETshare 0.67 << tautological HIGH 0.93), NOT slippage (strong in COMPLEX), NOT CpG (strongest nonCpG), and CONSERVATIVE vs mapping bias (at drifted sites the reference is the DERIVED allele, so mapping bias suppresses RETURN - signal appears despite that). POPULATION-WIDE, not a subgroup: per-child RETURN-frac mean 0.70 SD 0.17, zero high-tail kids. Remaining to make airtight: private-only cut + trinucleotide-context null + 2nd ancestral reconstruction (merged 3.04M table persists on box EBS, stopped). This SUPPORTS the homeward/reversion hypothesis at genome scale. Box STOPPED.

That headline was inflated by tautology leakage from VRARE/MED folded into RARE (RETshare climbs 0.62->0.85->0.92->0.94 with frequency). DEFENSIBLE result: a real, highly significant, SMALL population-wide reversion bias toward the ancestral base in fresh de-novo. Remaining optional: 2nd ancestral reconstruction.
